objective: Compare learned residual updater, learned zero-residual updater and predictor-only AdaJEPA-style updates across official PHYRE folds

updater.trainable: updater only; freeze initial_tokens and predictor
updater.zero_definition: independently trained with residual always zero; preserve selected action and failure/update history
updater.residual: observed latent minus prediction conditioned on current tokens
updater.loss: query future latent L1 + 0.03 * frozen-probe geometry loss
updater.loss_states: average over all actual updated states, then average episodes
updater.empty_support_policy: retain record, zero updater gradient, no resampling
updater.bptt: full; no stale residual cache; ranking argmax detached

adajepa_style.trainable: last predictor transformer block and final LayerNorm; Q0 initial tokens frozen
adajepa_style.optimizer: Adam recreated each adaptation call; model weights persist within scene
adajepa_style.reset: all adapted weights and buffer each scene

calibration.selection: S9 then S20 then fewer steps then lower lr

evaluation.task_selection: fixed deterministic template-balanced selection before outcomes
evaluation.candidate_selection: validity-only stable action order from fixed cache; no model-based shortlist
evaluation.anchor_historical_pool: keep prior pools as separately labelled diagnostic; new common main pool for all six methods

pending_assets: new fold train packs, support/query manifests, per-fold probe/scorer and initial-action evaluation pools; all require provenance checks
